notable_absence.finding: The page never explains the ro_N / rw_N prefixes that every stat name in the example response carries (ro_0, ro_1, ro_2, ro_3, rw_0, rw_1, rw_2, rw_3) - a reader has to already know that cbstats groups Couchstore engine stats per read-only and per read-write KVStore shard instance; the table documents only the suffix field names (backend_type, close, failure_get, failure_open, failure_set, failure_vbset, lastCommDocs, numLoadedVb, open), never the prefix scheme itself.

cross_component_finding: The response table is explicitly captioned 'Couchstore database engine stats' with no equivalent table, callout, or field variant for Magma, even though 'kvstore' is a generic-sounding command name that gives no indication its documented field set is engine-specific - readers on a Magma-backed bucket get no guidance on what backend_type/close/failure_* actually look like for their engine from this page alone.
